# Digital Feng Shui

> An online course that helps you redesign your Mac and iPhone so they protect your focus instead of scattering it. Step by step, finished in one afternoon (3–5 hours). It's not a discipline problem, it's a design problem.

Digital Feng Shui is made by Rimbout Bobeldijk. The course is optimized for Mac, with browser and phone chapters that also work on iOS and Android. One-time payment, lifetime access, and a 30-day money-back guarantee.

## The course

- [Digital Feng Shui: From Chaos to Clarity in One Afternoon](https://www.digital-fengshui.com/): what the course is, who it is for, the 8 modules, pricing, reviews and FAQ

Modules: Reclaim Your Focus · The Big Clean-Up · Mobile Feng Shui · Browser Feng Shui · Essential Tools · Shortcut Mastery · Clarity Systems · Flow By Design
